    LargeIndecomposable.CriticalFigure16Quotient.quotientDiagram

    The exact BGRS Figure-16 selected-corner quotient #

    For two singular pairs with a common first arrow, BGRS 4.5 quotients the full subcategory on the common source and middle and the two branch targets by the two relations alpha tau beta and alpha tau gamma. In the ordinary primitive-projective convention these relations are

    (beta ≫ tau) ≫ alpha and (gamma ≫ tau) ≫ alpha.

    This file starts the exact duplicate-free selected-corner construction. The six vertices in the printed affine-D5 source are occurrences of only three ambient objects; the common source is additionally required to form the two relation generators.
